response.overview: A documentary on the life of beloved Hispanic comedian Freddy Soto. From El Paso, Texas to Hollywood, California, he chased his dream of being a stand-up comic. But on the cusp of stardom, the laughter ended. Featuring interviews from Dane Cook, Paul Rodriguez, Johnny Sanchez, Jon Lovitz, Al Mardrigal, Brian Holzman, and many others.
response.title: REGARDLESS: THE FREDDIE SOTO STORY
